caption: The drawing depicts a single dagger placed vertically with the blade pointing downward, centered on a plain, off-white background. The dagger consists of three main parts: a blade, a guard, and a handle. The blade is stone-like, grayish-brown in color, and has a slightly rough texture with subtle lighter and darker spots; it is elongated with a rounded tip. The cross-guard is simple and straight, with a rectangular shape matching the color and texture of the blade. The handle is cylindrical, extending upward from the guard, and features a twisted or spiraled pattern. The overall color palette consists mainly of shades of gray and brown. The drawing style is realistic, showing fine details of texture and shading. There is a small, neatly written signature below and to the right of the dagger.
title: Knife
